verdict.rationale: First-party docs say users can 'trace any statement by following in-line citations back to the source paper.' Generated notes and reports carry citations that link back to source papers, and deep reviews produce a written synthesis tied to a ranked paper list. A community user also praised Undermind for reliably returning references, unlike general LLMs. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on confirmation that in-line citations accurately support each claim, and in-depth documentation of how citation granularity works (e.g., passage-level anchoring).
